name: paycheck-ledger-demo
description: Demo of a paycheck ledger with invented data: log checks, forecast the next one, and see where the year's taxes are heading.

paragraphs: A single-page app for logging paychecks, forecasting the next one, and tracking where the year's taxes are heading, shown here with invented data.

A setup panel says how you're paid and what comes out of each check: hourly or salary; weekly, every two weeks, twice a month or monthly (hourly pay is weekly or every two weeks); your W-4 filing status; health, dental and vision premiums; an HSA or not (it needs a high-deductible, or CDHP, health plan); a Roth, traditional or no 401k, and what percent; an ESPP or not; and what share of each check goes to savings. Anything you don't have disappears from the app. While the sample year is showing, it's redone to match whatever you pick.

A first visit opens an empty ledger with the setup showing. Try the example year loads an invented sample to look around in, and Start my own ledger clears it again. If you start partway through the year, copy the year-to-date column from your last stub into the starting totals, so the totals, projections and tax outlook cover the whole year.
